title: "Functions and methods"
---

<!-- Generated by scripts/functions-reference.py from stubs/phit.php. Do not edit. -->

phit provides 235 functions in the `Phit` namespace, the fit and table objects the models return, and the `CsvReader` class. Each name links to its reference entry. Import functions with `use function Phit\{...};`.

## Models

| Function | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [`fit_ols()`](models.qmd#fit_ols) | Fit a linear model from a formula, like R's lm(). |
| [`fit_generalized_linear()`](models.qmd#fit_generalized_linear) | Fit a Gaussian, binomial, or Poisson GLM from a formula, like R's glm(). |
| [`model_matrix()`](models.qmd#model_matrix) | Build the numeric design of a formula, like R's model.matrix(). |
| [`predict()`](models.qmd#predict) | Predict new data from a formula fit, with standard errors or intervals. |
| [`fit_ols_matrix()`](models.qmd#fit_ols_matrix) | Fit a linear model by least squares on a numeric design. |
| [`fit_logistic_matrix()`](models.qmd#fit_logistic_matrix) | Fit a binomial logit model on a numeric design. |
| [`fit_probit_matrix()`](models.qmd#fit_probit_matrix) | Fit a binomial probit model on a numeric design. |
| [`fit_poisson_matrix()`](models.qmd#fit_poisson_matrix) | Fit a Poisson log-link model on a numeric design. |
| [`summary()`](models.qmd#summary) | Print a model fit as R's print(summary(fit)) does. |
| [`tidy()`](models.qmd#tidy) | Return a fit's coefficient table as columns, like broom's tidy(). |

## Mixed models

| Function | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [`fit_mixed_gaussian()`](mixed-models.qmd#fit_mixed_gaussian) | Fit a Gaussian mixed model from an lme4 formula, like lme4::lmer(). |
| [`fit_mixed_logistic()`](mixed-models.qmd#fit_mixed_logistic) | Fit a binomial logit model with one random intercept from a formula, like lme4::glmer(). |
| [`fit_mixed_gaussian_matrix()`](mixed-models.qmd#fit_mixed_gaussian_matrix) | Fit a Gaussian mixed model on a numeric design with explicit random terms. |
| [`fit_mixed_gaussian_intercept_matrix()`](mixed-models.qmd#fit_mixed_gaussian_intercept_matrix) | Fit a Gaussian model with one random intercept by ML on a numeric design. |
| [`fit_mixed_logistic_matrix()`](mixed-models.qmd#fit_mixed_logistic_matrix) | Fit a binomial logit model with one random intercept on a numeric design. |

## Descriptive statistics and optimization

| Function | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [`stat_mean()`](statistics.qmd#stat_mean) | Arithmetic mean. |
| [`stat_median()`](statistics.qmd#stat_median) | Median. |
| [`stat_var()`](statistics.qmd#stat_var) | Sample or population variance. |
| [`stat_sd()`](statistics.qmd#stat_sd) | Sample or population standard deviation. |
| [`stat_quantile()`](statistics.qmd#stat_quantile) | One sample quantile, R type 7. |
| [`stat_quantile_array()`](statistics.qmd#stat_quantile_array) | Several sample quantiles from one sort, R type 7. |
| [`stat_weighted_mean()`](statistics.qmd#stat_weighted_mean) | Weighted mean. |
| [`stat_weighted_var()`](statistics.qmd#stat_weighted_var) | Weighted variance with frequency, reliability, or population weights. |
| [`stat_cov()`](statistics.qmd#stat_cov) | Sample or population covariance of two aligned arrays. |
| [`stat_cor()`](statistics.qmd#stat_cor) | Pearson correlation of two aligned arrays. |
| [`stat_density()`](statistics.qmd#stat_density) | Kernel density estimate, like R's density(). |
| [`stat_bw_nrd0()`](statistics.qmd#stat_bw_nrd0) | Silverman's rule-of-thumb bandwidth, like R's bw.nrd0(). |
| [`stat_bw_nrd()`](statistics.qmd#stat_bw_nrd) | Scott's variation of the rule-of-thumb bandwidth, like R's bw.nrd(). |
| [`stat_approx()`](statistics.qmd#stat_approx) | Linear or step interpolation, like R's approx(). |
| [`stat_ecdf()`](statistics.qmd#stat_ecdf) | Empirical CDF at given points. |
| [`optimize()`](statistics.qmd#optimize) | Minimize or maximize a function on an interval, like R's optimize(). |
| [`uniroot()`](statistics.qmd#uniroot) | Find a root of a function on an interval, like R's uniroot(). |

## Posterior draws

| Function | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [`draws_moments()`](draws.qmd#draws_moments) | Weighted mean and covariance of posterior draws. |
| [`draws_covariance_map()`](draws.qmd#draws_covariance_map) | Matrix that maps one covariance to another. |
| [`draws_affine()`](draws.qmd#draws_affine) | Apply an affine transformation to every draw. |

## Sampling

| Function | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [`dist_uniform_rng()`](sampling.qmd#dist_uniform_rng) | Seeded uniform samples. |
| [`dist_categorical_rng()`](sampling.qmd#dist_categorical_rng) | Seeded category indices drawn with given probabilities. |
| [`dist_categorical_rows_rng()`](sampling.qmd#dist_categorical_rows_rng) | One seeded category index per row of probabilities. |
| [`permutation_rng()`](sampling.qmd#permutation_rng) | A seeded random permutation or sample without replacement. |
| [`dist_{family}_rng()`](distributions.qmd) | Seeded samples from one of the 13 parameterizations below. |

## CSV input

| Function | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [`read_csv()`](csv.qmd#read_csv) | Read a delimited text file into typed columns. |
| [`CsvReader`](csv.qmd#CsvReader) | Class: read a CSV file a chunk of rows at a time. |

## Distributions

Each family has these functions, in scalar form and with an `_array` suffix over a list of points. Discrete families have `pmf` and `logpmf` in place of `pdf` and `logpdf`.

| Family | pdf / pmf | logpdf / logpmf | cdf | logcdf | sf | logsf | quantile | rng |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Normal](distributions.qmd#normal) | [`pdf`](distributions.qmd#dist_normal_pdf) | [`logpdf`](distributions.qmd#dist_normal_logpdf) | [`cdf`](distributions.qmd#dist_normal_cdf) | [`logcdf`](distributions.qmd#dist_normal_logcdf) | [`sf`](distributions.qmd#dist_normal_sf) | [`logsf`](distributions.qmd#dist_normal_logsf) | [`quantile`](distributions.qmd#dist_normal_quantile) | [`rng`](distributions.qmd#dist_normal_rng) |
| [Student's t](distributions.qmd#t) | [`pdf`](distributions.qmd#dist_t_pdf) | [`logpdf`](distributions.qmd#dist_t_logpdf) | [`cdf`](distributions.qmd#dist_t_cdf) | [`logcdf`](distributions.qmd#dist_t_logcdf) | [`sf`](distributions.qmd#dist_t_sf) | [`logsf`](distributions.qmd#dist_t_logsf) | [`quantile`](distributions.qmd#dist_t_quantile) | [`rng`](distributions.qmd#dist_t_rng) |
| [Chi-square](distributions.qmd#chisquare) | [`pdf`](distributions.qmd#dist_chisquare_pdf) | [`logpdf`](distributions.qmd#dist_chisquare_logpdf) | [`cdf`](distributions.qmd#dist_chisquare_cdf) | [`logcdf`](distributions.qmd#dist_chisquare_logcdf) | [`sf`](distributions.qmd#dist_chisquare_sf) | [`logsf`](distributions.qmd#dist_chisquare_logsf) | [`quantile`](distributions.qmd#dist_chisquare_quantile) | [`rng`](distributions.qmd#dist_chisquare_rng) |
